name: kvk-management-system
description: ERP for Krishi Vigyan Kendras and a farmer booking app, on Firebase (Spark plan: Hosting + Auth + Firestore)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n emu,erp,farmer -c green,blue,magenta "npm run emulators" "npm run dev:erp" "npm run dev:farmer"
scripts.build: rm -rf hosting && npm run build -w apps/farmer && npm run build -w apps/erp
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --project prod --only hosting,firestore
